d:
Gujrat ka bhujori ganv apni 500 sal purani bunaee ki paranpra aur hath se banaee jane vali shol ke lie duniya bhar men mashhur hai. ganv men bunkar aur rabari parivar milkar hath se bunaee aur karhaee ka kam karte hain. samay ke sath, yah kala paranprik shol se aage barhkar sari, stol, dres matiriyal aur kaee dusre tarah ke kapron tak pahunch gaee hai, jinhen amerika aur yurop ke deshon men eksaport kiya jata hai.
Riport: aashutosh garhvi
Edit: krunal desaee
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
